"""Seal only after actual native save/history/check and post-finalization preservation."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

from common import (
    BASE,
    ROOT,
    TARGET,
    TARGET_SHA,
    bind,
    current,
    external_new,
    now,
    read,
    verify,
    write,
)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--native-completion", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--final-files", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--preservation", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    current()
    from lineage import verify_native_completion

    completion, assembly, doc, cfg, adoption = verify_native_completion(args.native_completion)
    assert completion["status"] == "saved_review_and_history_checked"
    for key in ["canonical_yaml", "canonical_markdown", "history"]:
        verify(completion[key])
    for binding in completion["actual_receipts"].values():
        verify(binding)
        receipt = read(binding["path"])
        assert receipt["exit_code"] == 0
        verify(receipt["stdout"])
        verify(receipt["stderr"])
    files = read(args.final_files)
    verify(files["native_completion"])
    from lineage import verify_completion_archive

    verify(files["completion_archive"])
    verify_completion_archive(files["completion_archive"]["path"], args.native_completion)
    assert files["native_completion"] == bind(args.native_completion)
    from lineage import verify_current_inventory

    verify_current_inventory(files["all_current_files"])
    assert files["baseline"] == adoption["baseline"]
    verify(files["baseline"])
    preservation = read(args.preservation)
    assert preservation["status"] == "passed" and not preservation["problems"]
    assert preservation["baseline"] == adoption["baseline"]
    assert preservation["baseline_kgx"] == adoption["baseline_kgx"]
    assert preservation["gate_receipt"] == cfg["gates"]
    assert not preservation["lost_contexts"]
    assert not preservation["unexpected_context_nodes"]
    assert preservation["target_sha256"] == TARGET_SHA
    assert preservation["approved_extra_files"] is not None
    approval = verify(preservation["approved_extra_files"])
    assert read(approval) == read(args.final_files.parent / "approved-extra-files.json")
    assert preservation["old_record_count"] == 227 and preservation["old_review_bundles"] == 101
    assert preservation["new_edges"] == 111 and preservation["old_edge_cells_exact"]
    output = external_new(args.output)
    output.mkdir()
    status = {
        "status": "sealed_native_finalization_complete_pending_root_git_lifecycle",
        "at": now(),
        "base": BASE,
        "target": bind(ROOT / TARGET),
        "review_id": completion["review_id"],
        "reviewer_role": "author/self-review packaging with exact independent scie"
        "ntific inheritance",
        "canonical_yaml": completion["canonical_yaml"],
        "canonical_markdown": completion["canonical_markdown"],
        "history": completion["history"],
        "native_completion": bind(args.native_completion),
        "post_finalization_preservation": bind(args.preservation),
        "final_files": bind(args.final_files),
        "exact_current_file_count": len(files["all_current_files"]),
        "issues": [
            {
                "issue": 438,
                "stable_key": "lyxose-plar-kdgr-reciprocal-expression-omission",
            },
            {
                "issue": 439,
                "stable_key": "lyxose-pectin-digest-reporter-context-omission",
            },
        ],
        "issue_status": "Independent scientific fixes accepted; no issue closure or merge claim.",
        "source_exhaustion": False,
    }
    write(output / "handoff.json", status)
    print(bind(output / "handoff.json"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
